release_notes:
## Scanning reels is much faster
- Scanning used to read the timeline one property at a time — each track's clip count, then each sampled clip's name, start and end, individually. Every one of those is a separate round trip to Premiere, so a few reels of a busy stringout spent minutes waiting on the connection rather than doing work. Each reel's tracks are now read in a single call
- The tail leader search no longer looks at clips that could never be it. Only the LAST clip of a track can be the tail leader, and it only checks V1 plus the tracks between the Video Reference track and the episode title cards — it used to check the last clip of every track above V4, including tracks above the title cards where the tail never lives
- The Video Reference track is now identified by its first clip alone, since the reference is the only clip on its track
- Title card collection reads every clip's name and position in one call instead of four separate reads per clip
